prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART character review board. Uniform neutral medium grey opaque backdrop. Exactly two columns: front-left full body and matching back-right full body of SAME person per row. Different rows are independent people, no interaction. Compact stocky game sprite proportions and conspicuously chunky square pixel clusters, simple 3-tone clothing, selective dark outline, small simple faces. Muted earth wool, linen and worn leather; simple medieval round/tie neck cuts. No modern lapels, suits, uniforms, medical symbols, fantasy ornament, magic, text, labels, border, scenery, agreement, payment or resolved quest. All appearance, hair, exact age, and gender where source unspecified are proposals, not narrative canon. No invented injuries or diagnoses. Native grid, palette, animation and runtime unverified. TWO rows. TOP QIDUO adult male injured miner, older brother of AIQIN, dark short hair and stubble, dusty charcoal-brown tunic and trousers, seated on simple backless stool in guarded exhausted posture, hands resting gently in lap, one leg held carefully forward in protective posture. Dialogue establishes LEG injury, but not exact diagnosis or side: no invented bandage, blood, amputation or specific lesion. BOTTOM AIQIN adult female daughter of deceased maintenance worker and QIDUOs sister, dark braid, slate-blue dress and faded brown shawl, holds one old plain modest metal family cup without heraldic proof. No dead father body, cavalry uniform, noble title, cured injury, rescue staging or paid wages. These are separate neutral character studies, not a scene proving QIDUO already left the mine.
